description: This file defines the PHP class I18NGroupSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM project. It extends a base FilterParams class and specifies allowed sort fields for search filtering related to internationalization groups.

classes.name: I18NGroupSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object for filtering search results of internationalization groups, extending the base FilterParams.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to null.
